journey.name: onchain expired payment cancel
journey.description: Verifies that cancelling an expired Shop payment keeps other on-chain payments blocked until the cancellation is final, and does not report the payment as cancelled before then. Precondition: an onboarded funded dev wallet, PIN for payments enabled, a synced node, and a retained unresolved software on-chain payment for a Paykit Shop request whose candidate never reached the network and whose request has since ended. Creating that fixture needs a controlled refusal and a Paykit Shop request, which the Capabilities table does not provide; a seeded fixture must be labelled as state injection, never as proof of a native fault. Mining the 6 confirmations needs a regtest miner, so the unlock steps are Manual Tests. Manual Tests must also confirm against the backend that the cancellation spends the original inputs, pays only this wallet, and pays a higher fee than the original candidate, and that Cancel payment on the reopened Pending payment suggests a higher fee rate than the release paid.

actions.action: Open the retained original payment's Pending screen and verify it offers Cancel expired payment (testTag "AbandonExpiredOnchainPayment")
Tap Cancel expired payment and verify a dialog says the payment's request has ended and Bitkit sends the payment's coins back to the wallet for a network fee
Tap Continue and verify Pending says it is checking the network
Verify a dialog asks to send the payment's coins back to the wallet and shows the network fee in sats; tap Yes, Send and verify the normal payment PIN screen appears before dispatch
Enter the fixture's normal payment PIN without recording entered digits
Verify a toast and Pending say the cancellation was sent but is not confirmed yet and that other on-chain payments unlock once it has 6 confirmations, and that no toast says the payment was cancelled
Verify Pending stays open, no longer offers Cancel expired payment, Retry original payment or Retry without checking, and still offers Cancel payment

Close the sheet, start a new on-chain send, and verify it is refused back to the original Pending payment, which still offers Cancel payment but not Cancel expired payment, Retry original payment or Retry without checking
After the wallet syncs, verify the original Pending payment shows Cancellation sent with the cancellation's transaction ID and does not offer Cancel expired payment
Tap Cancel payment, continue with the suggested fee rate, and verify Pending says an earlier cancellation is still pending, not that a higher fee may help
After the cancellation has 6 confirmations and the wallet syncs, verify a Payment Cancelled toast appears and a new on-chain send reaches its confirmation screen
